name: Sleet
description: The cloud with a drop and a flake

shapes._why: three lobes, each an arc whose radius is set by the chord it spans — 4 across 7.76, 5 across 9.62, 5.5 across 10.06 — which no constructor takes as an argument
a drop: a point above one round belly
a flake: two bars crossing at their middle, which is as many crossings as one drawing may hold
